The reflected contact has no corresponding real action.

From 00:02.25 to 00:04.00 the real man's hand is raised to the side of his head, with a dark comb-like object running through the hair above the ear. In the reflection, the hand is at the center of the forehead, drawing a white razor horizontally across the eyebrow/forehead. The reflected action does not follow the real hand's position or motion.

Repeated dry razor strokes across chin, lip, eyebrow/forehead and hairline (00:02.25-00:04.00 especially) leave no visible effect. No hair is removed, no stubble changes, and there is no foam, residue or skin reaction. The eyebrow and hairline strokes should visibly alter hair if the blade is really contacting it.
